ValidationRule.description: Deactivated 13 Sep 2026: Approve is the finance hand-off for UAEDDS too and queues createDDAMandate via submitApprovedUAEDDSMandates. Approve still creates a DirectDebit_Transactions__c row, inert only while Request_Type__c is blank.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Approve applies to FAB mandates only. A UAEDDS mandate is progressed from the Direct Debit app, not by ticking Approve, because Approve would submit this record to the FAB gateway.
